Query OK, 0 rows affected (0.052 sec)

mysql> SELECT 
    -> COUNT(CASE WHEN gender = 'M' THEN 1 END) AS male_count,
    -> COUNT(CASE WHEN gender = 'F' THEN 1 END) AS female_count
    -> FROM patients;

mysql> -- Show patient_id, first_name, last_name, and attending doctors specialty. Show only the patients who have a diagnosis as 'Epilepsy' and the doctors first name is 'Lisa'.
Query OK, 0 rows affected (0.045 sec)

mysql> SELECT 
    -> pat.patient_id,
    -> pat.first_name AS patient_first_name,
    -> pat.last_name AS patient_last_name,
    -> admi.diagnosis AS admissions_diagnosis,
    -> doc.specialty AS doctor_specialty,
    -> doc.first_name AS doctor_first_name
    -> FROM patients pat
    -> JOIN admissions admi 
    -> ON pat.patient_id = admi.patient_id
    -> JOIN doctors doc 
    -> ON admi.attending_doctor_id = doc.doctor_id
    -> WHERE admi.diagnosis = 'Epilepsy'
    -> AND doc.first_name = 'Lisa';
